title: His Highness Prince Rahim Aga Khan V calls on Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi
subtitle:
PM appreciates AKDN’s longstanding contributions to India’s development priorities
PM commends the Network’s work in heritage conservation and restoration
His Highness the Aga Khan reaffirms AKDN’s commitment to India’s inclusive growth and social progress
body_text:
His Highness Prince Rahim Aga Khan V, Chairman of the Aga Khan Development Network (AKDN), called on Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi in New Delhi today.
Prime Minister appreciated AKDN’s longstanding contributions in India, particularly in sustainable urban development, water conservation, healthcare, rural sanitation, skill development for youth and women empowerment.
Prime Minister also commended AKDN’s pioneering efforts in preserving India’s cultural heritage through the restoration and rejuvenation of historic sites across the country.
His Highness the Aga Khan reaffirmed AKDN’s commitment to India’s inclusive growth and social progress. He appreciated India’s transformative development initiatives and shared his perspectives on the role of innovation in advancing human welfare.
